patterns.description: Los seller outcomes reportados en el corpus se separan en polos: sellers con resultados altos visibles ($61,411 en un año; ~$15,000 en 2025; $65.15 en 4 horas con $50-200/día de ingreso orgánico) co-ocurren con sellers con resultados marginales o nulos ($139.96 en 3 años; ~$21 en una semana; cero tráfico orgánico con 35 listings; cero vistas con 26 productos). TC-001 ya cubre este patrón de asimetría distributiva con cards de otras rondas.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-062: Seller with 26 products: zero organic views and zero Discover views; all views from own traffic

patterns.routing_rationale: Pattern overlaps substantially with TC-001 (seller income asymmetry). Per scan-asymmetries skill: TC-001 already covers seller income asymmetry. Reference TC-001. Do not produce a duplicate. All actor values for these cards are actor=seller. Same-actor filter: all signal IDs across both poles have actor=seller → same_actor_discrepancy additionally applies. Route to rejected_grouping with reference to TC-001.

patterns.routing_rationale: Polo marketplace (actor=marketplace) documents large catalog visible in Discover. Polo seller (actor=seller) documents sellers receiving zero organic/Discover traffic. Actor values differ: marketplace vs seller. Different actor values → passes same-actor filter. Both poles have card support (3+ cards each). Clear distributional skew: platform presents large catalog while individual sellers document zero discovery. Generates DT question about discoverability mechanics.
